Per the finite-disk policy only firsthand-benchmark.md text was preserved; the mise standalone binary, the installed toolchains (node/jq/gh), and the isolated MISE_DATA_DIR were discarded. The fixture/*.toml configs, run.sh, and probe.sh here are RECONSTRUCTED from the recorded methodology so a third party can reproduce the METHOD. results.json holds the behavioral judgments + timings measured on 2026-06-29 with mise v2026.6.14 — re-running today drifts (mise ships ~monthly; tool versions move). environment.note: Timing is machine-dependent; the cold-vs-warm SHAPE and the ratios are the portable signals, not absolute milliseconds on this specific PC. Behavioral observations (trust gate, shim fallback, lockfile contents, supply-chain verification tiers) are the durable claims.

subjects.name: mise
subjects.note: Standalone exe does NOT bundle mise-shim.exe, so it falls back to 'file' shim mode on Windows. Scoop/winget installs ship mise-shim.exe and get 'exe' shim mode.

subjects.name: jq
subjects.note: aqua config = checksum-only (sha256sum.txt from the same release). Integrity, not provenance.

subjects.name: gh
subjects.note: aqua config has GitHub artifact attestation -> mise verifies provenance via mise-versions.jdx.dev API, then checksum.

drift_warning: mise ships ~monthly; v2026.6.14 and the exact seconds here are already gone. The DURABLE claims are behavioral/structural: (1) an untrusted mise.toml is REFUSED at parse time (TOFU trust gate) until `mise trust`; (2) the standalone exe falls back to 'file' shim mode (mise-shim.exe absent) so shims depend on mise being on PATH; (3) mise.lock, when enabled, records cross-platform sha256 + URL per (os,arch), not just a version string, and is OFF by default; (4) supply-chain verification comes in tiers (core lock sha256 / aqua checksum-only / aqua attestation) with DIFFERENT guarantees; (5) warm reinstall is idempotent (near-zero) and the file-shim adds a small per-call overhead. Exact ms and the node/jq/gh patch versions are a 2026-06-29 snapshot.
